title: chore(pm): delete changeset-deadline-census, a report-only tool nothing calls
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"huangyiirene"} -->
_Requested by **Irene** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67x?thread=cmsg_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67xVumqueHL5J4KQkU9CweTLS)_

Part of #29471 (family T1 of the census in comment 6586191438). The card stays open: it closes only when the 30-day net change of `scripts/pm` is below zero.

## What changes

Deletes the changeset-deadline census, a report-only tool that nothing calls:

- `scripts/pm/changeset-deadline-census.mjs` (798 lines, the tool and its self-test)
- the `check:pm-changeset-deadline-census` script line in `package.json`
- its `Changeset-deadline census self-test` step in `.github/workflows/lint.yml` (the step and its comment block, 24 lines)

The diff is −823 / +0, with no other file touched. `docs/audits/gate-census-2026-09.md` keeps its two rows as history; that audit already rowed this script `retire`.

## Why

The card's census found no reader for this tool on `origin/main`:

- no skill, agent or `AGENTS.md` text names it
- no workflow runs it live; its only run was its own `--self-test` step in `lint.yml`
- no other script imports it

Of the seat-signed comments in the 30-day window, the ones that name it are dev reports listing it as a derived gate family ("--self-test exit 0"). No seat ran it for its output. Its self-test was therefore a cost on every dispatch touching `scripts/**` and was read by no one. `instrument-discipline.md` gives a report-only instrument no in-flight work except deletion.

## Verification

- `node scripts/check-commit-card-trailers.mjs --range origin/main..HEAD` → exit 0
- `git grep changeset-deadline-census` leaves only the two history rows in `docs/audits/gate-census-2026-09.md`
- `package.json` still parses as JSON, and `lint.yml` still parses as YAML
- `dispatch-gates --commands` derived 63 gate commands for this diff, and each was run with its exit code recorded before any pipe. 59 exited 0. 4 exited 3 with PREREQUISITE NOT MET because they read build output and this container has no `dist/`: `check:dts-closure`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure` and `check:sourcemap-no-sources-content`. They are NOT MEASURED locally, and CI's Build Core job runs them. `check:self-test-wired` and `check:step-collectors` are among the 59, so the script line and the step leave together.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

No changeset: the diff publishes nothing from any released package, so the PR carries `skip-changeset`.

**Landing:** `.github/workflows/lint.yml` is a governed Tier H surface. This PR stays a draft until an account in `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` approves it.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (not touched)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind. (nothing added)
- [x] 3. No formatter ran. No linted source changed: the diff deletes one file and edits JSON and YAML.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset. (publishes nothing: `skip-changeset`)
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (not touched)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
